subject.title: Support Qwen Cloud personal token plan, and unblock Alibaba Token Plan on Linux

question: Should CodexBar officially support Qwen Cloud personal-token-plan usage as a manual-cookie-only Alibaba Token Plan region?
rationale: The patch is more than a bug repair: it introduces a new provider variant, a new persisted region value, and an intentional no-browser-import setup boundary that requires repository product ownership.

options.title: Sponsor the Qwen region
options.body: Approve the manual-cookie-only Qwen Cloud region after compatibility validation of the existing Team Edition and supported-platform setup paths.

options.title: Keep Team Edition only
options.body: Decline the new supported region and retain the existing Alibaba Team Edition provider scope until a broader provider policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Qwen region
recommendation.body: Approve the manual-cookie-only Qwen Cloud region after compatibility validation of the existing Team Edition and supported-platform setup paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this the most likely available decision route for accepting a new supported provider surface.
